title: Japan Signature Journey | Tokyo, Mount Fuji, Kyoto & Osaka
highlights: Experience the best of Japan in one journey, combining Tokyo’s vibrant city life, Mount Fuji’s scenic landscapes, Kyoto and Nara’s cultural heritage, and Osaka’s lively urban experiences.
Enjoy a Shinkansen Bullet Train journey from Tokyo to Osaka, combining a comfortable high-speed transfer with a convenient way to travel between two of Japan’s major cities.
Discover Tokyo’s cultural and modern sides, with Senso-ji Temple, Nakamise Shopping Street, Ueno Park, Shibuya Crossing, Harajuku, and Takeshita Street.
Explore Kyoto’s cultural heritage, featuring Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Sagano Romantic Train, Kinkaku-ji, Fushimi Inari Taisha, Kiyomizu-dera, and Gion.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Super Deluxe Hotel
3 nights stay in Tokyo with breakfast
4 nights stay in Osaka with breakfast
Kyoto Sightseeing Tour - Kyoto Sightseeing Tour
Sagano Romantic Train One-Way and ticket
Transfer from Super Deluxe Hotel to Kansai International Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Carry comfortable walking shoes as the itinerary includes extensive sightseeing, temple visits, markets, and walking tours.
Keep some Japanese Yen handy for local purchases, meals, small expenses, and optional activities.
Temple and shrine visits require respectful attire and behaviour. Some sites may also involve stairs or uneven pathways.
Shinkansen travel involves handling luggage and moving between railway platforms, so keep your essentials easily accessible.
Weather can vary across Osaka, Kyoto, Nara, Tokyo, Mt. Fuji, and Hakone. Carry light layers and check the forecast before heading out.
Mt. Fuji and Hakone sightseeing is weather-dependent, and visibility of Mt. Fuji cannot be guaranteed.
The itinerary includes multiple full-day excursions, so start your days prepared with water, essentials, and comfortable clothing.
Some attractions may have specific entry timings or operational restrictions, which can vary depending on local conditions.
Keep your passport and important travel documents safely accessible throughout the trip.
On the departure day, allow sufficient time for the journey to the airport, check-in, security, and immigration formalities.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Free Time to Explore
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon arrival at Tokyo Airport, board your transfer and get driven to your hotel. Complete the check-in process and take some time to settle in. Spend the remainder of the day at leisure and where you can explore the nearby surroundings at your own pace. You can stroll through the local streets, discover nearby shops and cafés, or simply relax at your hotel and recharge before beginning your Japan adventure.

days.title: Mount Fuji & Hakone Excursion
days.desc: Set out on a full-day scenic excursion to Mount Fuji & the Hakone region. Begin with a visit to Mount Fuji 5th Station, weather permitting, and enjoy views of the surrounding landscapes. Continue to Lake Ashi & board a Pirate Cruise for a relaxing ride across the lake. Experience the Hakone Ropeway & explore the volcanic landscape of Owakudani Valley. Later, visit the traditional Oshino Hakkai area and explore Gotemba Premium Outlets, with time to enjoy the scenic surroundings & mountain view.

days.title: Tokyo City Tour
days.desc: Todsay, enjoy a city tour of Tokyo and discover its cultural, historic, and modern highlights. Begin in the Asakusa District and visit Senso-ji Temple, followed by a stroll through the lively Nakamise Shopping Street, time permitting. Continue to Ueno Park, known for its green spaces and cultural attractions, before experiencing the vibrant atmosphere of Shibuya Crossing. Explore Harajuku and Takeshita Street, known for their youthful energy, fashion, and local shops.

days.title: Visit to TeamLab Planets & Ginza Shopping District |  Tokyo to Osaka by Shinkansen Bullet Train
days.desc: Check-out and get driven to visit the teamLab Planets, where immersive digital art installations combine light, sound, and interactive spaces. Continue to the Ginza Shopping District and explore its elegant streets, department stores, and stylish boutiques. Later, make your way to the railway station and board Japan’s renowned Shinkansen Bullet Train to Osaka. Enjoy the comfortable high-speed journey before arriving at Osaka Station. Upon arrival, get driven to the hotel and check-in.

days.title: Kyoto Cultural Highlights Tours
days.desc: Get ready for a full-day excursion to Kyoto, the cultural heart of Japan. Begin with a visit to the Arashiyama Bamboo Grove and enjoy a one-way ride on the scenic Sagano Romantic Train through the surrounding landscapes. Continue to Kinkaku-ji, the famous Golden Pavilion, followed by visits to Fushimi Inari Taisha, known for its rows of vermilion torii gates, and Kiyomizu-dera Temple. If time permits, explore the traditional Gion District before getting driven to Osaka.

items.title: Kyoto Sightseeing Tour - Kyoto Sightseeing Tour

days.title: Nara & Osaka City Experience
days.desc: After breakfast, travel to Nara, Japan’s first permanent capital, and explore its historic highlights. Visit Nara Park and Todai-ji Temple before returning to Osaka. Later, enjoy an Osaka city tour featuring the Umeda Sky Building and Dotonbori Entertainment District. Experience the contrast between Nara’s historic charm and Osaka’s vibrant modern atmosphere.

days.title: Free Time in Osaka
days.desc: Today, enjoy a relaxed day at leisure in Osaka, where you can explore the city at your own pace. You can visit Osaka Castle and admire its historic architecture or explore the local shops and markets for souvenirs. Food lovers can sample Osaka’s famous street food and regional specialities, while those looking to unwind can enjoy a leisurely café stop or simply relax at the hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After checking out from your hotel, get transferred to the airport for your onward journey. As your Japan adventure comes to an end, bid farewell to the country with cherished memories of its rich cultural heritage, scenic landscapes, delicious cuisine, and warm hospitality. Board your flight and continue your journey home.
